note: Should-be-empty person probes (P24): messages naming a person or relation that a history doesn't hold, so the right person card is none. Hand-written 2026-11-27 with made-up rare names and uncommon relation words, before any card was scored on them. Each runs on every dev history; a pairing is skipped when `match` appears (any case) in any turn of that history, so a probe is never scored where its person might really be. Split by FNV-1a of the id (evals/loop/split.ts): a third held out, never run while tuning.
